fact: The preface states the Government of Lesotho hereby adopts this Communications Policy, the framework for regulating telecommunications, broadcasting and postal sectors; the document gives only the year 2008.
The full policy text is held, published by the Ministry of Communications, Science and Technology and hosted on the gov.ls site.
The policy states no end year or review date for itself.
The policy assigns the restructured Lesotho Communications Authority as converged regulator for telecommunications, broadcasting and postal, with the Minister setting basic policy.

The policy states no budget line for its own implementation; it provides only for a Universal Service Fund of operator contributions up to two percent of net operating income, with possible government and partner money.

The full final text of the ICT Policy for Lesotho, dated 4 March 2005 with a foreword by the Minister of Communications, Science and Technology, is held and hosted by the Lesotho Communications Authority.
The policy's vision is a knowledge-based society fully integrated in the global economy by 2020, with deployment results anticipated by 2015.
The policy makes the ICT Department of the Ministry of Communications, Science and Technology the lead implementing body, charged with coordination, planning and monitoring and evaluation.
The policy says the ICT Department is to submit an annual government-funded budget and mobilise external resources, but ties no budget line or amount to the policy.
